title: Design System: Picnic In The Park

field.purpose: The page ground. Warm paper, never white.

field-deep.purpose: Recessed field: the budget track and sunken strips.

ink.purpose: Primary text. Warm near-black, never neutral.

ink-on-dark.purpose: Text over the photograph, on the scrim.

accent-terracotta.purpose: The only saturated chrome: primary action, visitor voice, focus.

accent-deep.purpose: Hover and press state for terracotta.

line.purpose: Decorative separation only: card edges, row dividers.

status-ideal-bg.purpose: Weather risk: ideal. Pairs with #14532d at 7.5:1.

status-caution-bg.purpose: Weather risk: acceptable. Pairs with #713f12 at 7.0:1.

status-rain-bg.purpose: Weather risk: rain. Pairs with #1e3a8a at 7.3:1.

status-heat-bg.purpose: Weather risk: heat. Pairs with #7f1d1d at 6.9:1.

status-unsafe-bg.purpose: Weather risk: unsafe. The one inverted chip; white ink at 8.6:1.

good-text.purpose: Budget remaining text and bar fill.

bad-text.purpose: Budget overrun text and bar fill.

focus.purpose: Focus outline on the primary action.

display.usage: The product name over the photograph. The only place the product speaks in its own voice.
display.family: ui-serif, Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, serif

headline.usage: The wizard heading. Serif, because a human wrote it.
headline.family: ui-serif, Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, serif

title.usage: Uppercase 0.08em connective tissue across cards, tables, and menu categories.
title.family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

body.usage: Everything an agent produced. Sans, 1.5 line height.
body.family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

label.family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: Agent cards and the primary button at rest. Warm, offset, two-layer.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Hover state for cards and the primary button.

shadows.name: hero
shadows.purpose: The wizard panel, which overlaps the photograph and needs the strongest separation.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Input focus. Paired with a terracotta border so the indicator survives if the ring is missed.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover, border, and background changes on controls.

motion.name: entrance
motion.purpose: The single authored entrance: title, subtitle, wizard, chat, staggered 0.1s to 0.44s.

motion.name: hero-settle
motion.purpose: The photograph settles from scale(1.14) to scale(1.06) once on load. The only moment the image moves.

motion.name: budget
motion.purpose: Budget bar fill, animated on transform: scaleX so it never forces layout.

breakpoints.name: rail-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Wizard rail narrows from 360px to 320px and the column gap tightens.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: Grid collapses to one column, rail unsticks, hero shortens, card grid goes 1fr.

breakpoints.name: container-max
breakpoints.purpose: Shared measure for the hero text block and the content grid, so the title aligns with the panels below it.

breakpoints.name: hero-height
breakpoints.purpose: Hero band height; drops to clamp(320px, 46vh, 460px) below the stack breakpoint.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The system's only button. Solid terracotta, 48px minimum target, white label at 6.1:1.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; background: #b03a0b; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 0.7rem; padding: 0.8rem 1.5rem; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(74,44,18,.06), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(74,44,18,.28); transition: background-color .18s ease, transform .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #8f2f09; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(74,44,18,.08), 0 18px 40px -16px rgba(74,44,18,.38); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #d9c6ad; color: #6b5947; cursor: not-allowed; box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #7a2b06; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: 44px minimum target. Focus draws a terracotta border plus a visible ring, on :focus-visible only.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-i">Party size</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-i" type="number" value="6">
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; margin-bottom: .4rem; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; color: #77604a; } .ds-input { min-height: 44px; width: 100%; background: #fffdfa; border: 1px solid #998063; border-radius: .7rem; padding: .6rem .8rem; font-family: inherit; font-size: .95rem; color: #2b1d14; transition: border-color .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #b03a0b; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(176,58,11,.28); }

components.name: Hero Header
components.description: The photograph, the scrim ramp, and the serif title. The scrim guarantees 5:1 for the title over the brightest pixel the image can produce.
components.html:
Picnic in the Park

Five agents work out the weather, the park, the menu, the budget and the invitations.
components.css: .ds-hero { position: relative; isolation: isolate; min-height: clamp(360px,58vh,620px); display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 3rem 2rem 4rem; overflow: hidden; color: #fffaf1; } .ds-hero::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -2; background: url('/hero.svg') center 42%/cover; transform: scale(1.06); } .ds-hero::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(48,24,9,.62) 0%, rgba(48,24,9,.5) 34%, rgba(60,32,12,.34) 58%, rgba(253,244,231,.5) 84%, #fdf4e7 100%); } .ds-hero-title { font-family: ui-serif, Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, serif; font-size: clamp(2.75rem,7vw,5rem); line-height: 1.02; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.03em; margin: 0 0 .6rem; max-width: 14ch; text-wrap: balance; text-shadow: 0 2px 24px rgba(40,20,6,.45); } .ds-hero-sub { font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1.5; color: #fdeacd; margin: 0; max-width: 46ch; text-shadow: 0 1px 12px rgba(40,20,6,.5); }

components.name: Wizard Panel
components.description: The most elevated surface. Frosted paper overlapping the photograph.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: rgba(255,253,248,.94); border: 1px solid #e0cfb4; border-radius: 1.25rem; padding: 1.75rem; backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.15); box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(56,30,10,.1), 0 40px 80px -32px rgba(56,30,10,.45); } .ds-panel-title { font-family: ui-serif, Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.02em; margin: 0; color: #2b1d14; }

components.name: Agent Card
components.description: One specialist agent's result. Recessed header strip, hidden emoji glyph, uppercase title.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fffdf9; border: 1px solid #e0cfb4; border-radius: 1rem; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(74,44,18,.06), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(74,44,18,.28); transition: transform .22s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .22s ease; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: #2b1d14; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(74,44,18,.08), 0 18px 40px -16px rgba(74,44,18,.38); } .ds-card-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .55rem; padding: .85rem 1.1rem; background: rgba(250,240,226,.72); border-bottom: 1px solid #e0cfb4; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; color: #5c4634; } .ds-card-body { padding: .9rem 1.1rem 1rem; font-size: .875rem; } .ds-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; } .ds-row-label { color: #77604a; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Weather risk and reservation status. Dark ink on a light chip; every pair clears 6.9:1. Never white text on a saturated fill.
components.html: Ideal Acceptable Risk:Rain Risk:Heat Unsafe
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: .2rem .6rem; border-radius: 999px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 700; background: #e7e0d5; color: #3f3a33; } .ds-chip-ideal { background: #bbf7d0; color: #14532d; } .ds-chip-caution { background: #fde68a; color: #713f12; } .ds-chip-rain { background: #bfdbfe; color: #1e3a8a; } .ds-chip-heat { background: #fecaca; color: #7f1d1d; } .ds-chip-unsafe { background: #991b1b; color: #fff; }

components.name: Budget Meter
components.description: Animates on transform: scaleX rather than width, so the fill never forces layout.

components.css: .ds-meter { height: 10px; background: #f7e9d6; border: 1px solid #e0cfb4; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: .6rem; } .ds-meter-fill { height: 100%; width: 100%; border-radius: 999px; background: #15803d; transform-origin: left center; transition: transform .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-meter-totals { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: .35rem; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: .875rem; color: #2b1d14; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-meter-good { color: #15803d; font-weight: 700; }

components.css: .ds-chat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.25rem; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-msg-user { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-msg-agent { display: flex; justify-content: flex-start; } .ds-bubble { border-radius: 1.25rem; padding: 1.1rem 1.35rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(74,44,18,.06), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(74,44,18,.28); } .ds-bubble p { margin: 0; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-bubble-user { background: #b03a0b; color: #fff; border-bottom-right-radius: .35rem; max-width: 70%; } .ds-bubble-agent { background: rgba(255,251,243,.9); border: 1px solid #e0cfb4; backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.15); border-bottom-left-radius: .35rem; width: 100%; color: #2b1d14; } .ds-plan-status { font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; color: #77604a; }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: Dense agent output. Header rule uses line-strong; row dividers use the decorative line and the last row drops its border.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: .85rem; color: #2b1d14; } .ds-table th { text-align: left; font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; color: #77604a; padding: .4rem .5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #998063; } .ds-table td { padding: .45rem .5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #e0cfb4; } .ds-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; } .ds-sub { display: block; font-size: .75rem; color: #77604a; }

narrative.overview: A planning tool for something pleasant, set at late afternoon. The product opens on a large photograph of a sunlit meadow and every working surface is warm frosted paper floating over it. The palette is warm end to end: field #fdf4e7, ink in warm browns rather than neutral grey, and a single saturated accent in terracotta #b03a0b. The mode is Operate. Past the hero the job is to fill in five fields and read what five agents came back with, so personality lives in the header, the paper, and the terracotta, while the working area stays quiet and scannable. The use scene decides the light: this surface is projected in a lit room during a demo and also read closely on a laptop, and both favour a bright, high-contrast field. There is no dark scheme, because the world is built on one specific photograph and one specific quality of light; a mechanical inversion would produce neither. The backdrop is wired through a single --hero-image custom property, so replacing the bundled hero.svg with a photograph changes the whole world's light in one line.
keyCharacteristics: A single photograph, only in the header, with the content grid pulled up -7rem to overlap it
A five-stop scrim ramp that guarantees 5:1 for the title over the brightest pixel the image can produce, then dissolves the photo into the page
Frosted paper panels at 0.90-0.94 alpha with backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.15)
Serif for the human voice, sans for everything an agent produced
Terracotta reserved for the primary action, the visitor's own bubble, and focus
Status as dark ink on light chips, every pair above 6.9:1
Warm, offset, two-layer shadows carrying elevation instead of borders
rules: Accent Scarcity: terracotta appears on the primary action, the visitor's voice, and focus. Nowhere else.
Ink on Light Chips: status never uses white text on a saturated fill; it is dark ink on a light chip of the same hue.
One Photograph: a single image, in the header only. Everything else is paper.
Scrim Before Type: no text sits on the photograph outside the scrim ramp.
Panels Overlap the Horizon: the content grid cuts into the hero, which is what makes the photograph read as depth rather than as a banner.
Serif for Voice, Sans for Data: display serif for human-authored headings only; all agent output is sans.
Two Line Strengths: line-strong when a boundary is a control, line when it is decoration.
Shadow Carries Elevation: borders stay at 1px and never do the lifting.
dos: Keep terracotta on the primary action, the visitor's voice, and focus
Put dark ink on light chips for every status and check the pair clears 4.5:1
Set anything a human wrote in the serif and anything an agent produced in the sans
Let shadows carry elevation and keep borders at one pixel
Use line-strong for control boundaries and line for decoration
Give controls a 44px minimum target, 48px for the primary action
Keep the panels overlapping the hero; the overlap is the composition
Swap --hero-image to change the whole world's light in one line
Use tabular-nums wherever costs align down a column
donts: Put text on the photograph outside the scrim ramp
Reach for gradient text, gradient buttons, or a colored left rule
Introduce a dark scheme by inverting this one
Let status colors drift into brand colors, or brand colors into status
Animate width, height, or top; animate transform and opacity
Add a second serif or a third family
Use neutral grey for secondary text; tint it from the warm ink ramp
